title: VibeInfrastructureManifest
description: JSON Schema for Vibe Infrastructure manifest (vibe.json) supporting both upstream infra definitions and consumer project dependency declarations.

role.description: Role of the current repository workspace: 'consumer' for end-user engineering projects consuming AI infra dependencies, 'provider' for infrastructure author repositories distributing Prompts, Skills, and Commands.

name.description: Identifier name of the AI infra repository (required when role is 'provider').

description.description: Human-readable description of this AI infra repository.

includes.description: Glob patterns specifying which AI infra configuration files are included for distribution (used when role is 'provider').

excludes.description: Glob patterns specifying which files are excluded from distribution.

infrastructures.description: Declared AI infra repository dependencies for consumer projects or derivative provider infras.

url.description: Git repository URL of the AI infra.

version.description: Target tracking version ('latest' by default to continuously track upstream releases) or explicitly pinned Git Tag, branch, or commit SHA.

includes.description: Optional glob patterns to selectively include AI infra configurations from this dependency.

excludes.description: Optional glob patterns to exclude certain configurations from this dependency.

anyOf.description: Backwards-compatible infrastructure provider manifest without explicit role.
Backwards-compatible consumer project manifest without explicit role.
